WITH product_profit AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    p.shelf_sqft,
    p.sell_price,
    p.cost_price,
    (p.sell_price - p.cost_price) AS profit_per_unit,
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.qty), 0) AS total_qty_june,
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.qty * (p.sell_price - p.cost_price)), 0) AS total_profit_june
  FROM store.products p
  LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON p.sku = ds.sku
  WHERE p.shelf_sqft > 0
  GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.shelf_sqft, p.sell_price, p.cost_price
)
SELECT 
  sku,
  name,
  shelf_sqft,
  profit_per_unit,
  total_qty_june,
  total_profit_june,
  ROUND(total_profit_june / shelf_sqft, 2) AS profit_per_sqft
FROM product_profit
ORDER BY profit_per_sqft DESC;
